def span_features(text, spans):
    if not spans:
        return []
    def hit(p, x):
        return bool(re.search(p, x, re.I))
    def context(a, b):
        lo = max(text.rfind("\n", 0, a), text.rfind(".", 0, a)) + 1
        z = max(a, b - 1)
        ends = [q for q in (text.find("\n", z), text.find(".", z)) if q >= 0]
        hi = min(ends) + 1 if ends else len(text)
        return text[lo:hi]
    out = []
    for a, b in spans:
        a = max(0, min(len(text), a)); b = max(a, min(len(text), b))
        d = text[a:b]; c = context(a, b)
        conf = hit(r"confidential|proprietary|evaluation material|data", c)
        out.append([
            conf and hit(r"mark(?:ed)?|identif(?:y|ied)|designat(?:ed|e)|label(?:led|ed)?|reduc(?:e|ed) to writ|summari[sz]ed in writing|recorded in .*minutes", c),
            hit(r"oral(?:ly)?|verbal|spoken|conveyed orally", d),
            conf and hit(r"circumstances?.*(?:confidential|proprietary)|reasonabl(?:e|y) (?:understood|regarded)|reasonable business person", c),
            conf and hit(r"deemed|automatically|shall constitute|shall be considered", c),
            hit(r"business|financ|customer|market|personnel|employee|operation|asset|contract|address|forecast|supplier|pricing", d),
            hit(r"technical|software|engineering|design|algorithm|invention|process|system|technology|source code", d),
            hit(r"shall not include|does not include|exclude[sd]?|obligations? (?:shall )?not (?:apply|extend)|cease to be confidential", c),
            hit(r"independent(?:ly)? (?:develop|creat|deriv|acquir)|developed .* without (?:use|access|reference)|independent development", c),
            hit(r"(?:received|available|obtained|learned).*(?:from|through) (?:a )?third part|source other than|from others|non.?confidential basis", c),
            hit(r"(?:right|free) to independently|may .*develop|may .*acquir|developing .* internally|receiv(?:e|ing)|obtain(?:ing)?", c) and hit(r"similar|competitive|other part|other person|third part", c)
        ])
    return out

        lo = max(text.rfind("\n", 0, a), text.rfind(".", 0, a)) + 1

        return text[lo:hi]
    out = []
    for a, b in spans:
        a = max(0, min(len(text), a)); b = max(a, min(len(text), b))
        d = text[a:b]; c = context(a, b)
        comp = hit(r"required by law|legal process|subpoena|court order|regulatory authority|governmental agency|judicial process", c)
        ret = hit(r"return|destroy|destruction|delete|erase|expunge", c)
        out.append([
            hit(r"(?:use|used).*(?:solely|only|exclusively).*purpose|sole (?:and exclusive )?purpose", c),
            hit(r"(?:shall|will|agree(?:s)? to) not use|not .*use.*other than|use .*for no .*purpose", c),
            comp,
            comp and hit(r"prompt .*notice|notify|inform|give .*notice", c),
            hit(r"(?:existence|terms|content).*agreement|agreement .*confidential", c) and hit(r"confidential|not disclose|not .*public", c),
            hit(r"discussion|negotiation|transaction", c) and hit(r"not disclose|no .*announcement|not .*public|confidential", c),
            hit(r"no (?:right|licen[cs]e)|does not grant|not .*construed .*grant|no .*conveyed", c),
            hit(r"remain .*property|exclusive property|reserves? all rights|own all rights", c),
            ret and hit(r"confidential|evaluation material|proprietary|copies|records|documents|information", c),
            hit(r"termination|expiration|ceas(?:e|ing)|abandon|conclusion|rejected|does not wish to proceed|ceases? to be interested", c),
            hit(r"upon .*request|at .*request|written (?:demand|request)|if .*requests", c),
            hit(r"may retain|entitled to retain|may keep|not required to (?:delete|destroy)|retain .*backup|retain .*archive|single copy .*retained", c),
            hit(r"surviv|continue to be bound|termination .*not affect|remain in effect|continue .*after termination", c),
            hit(r"(?:year|month)s? (?:after|following|from).*termin|post.?termination|survive .*period of", c),
            hit(r"retained|backup|back-up|archive", c) and hit(r"subject to|continue to apply|held in compliance|bound by|terms .*continue", c)
        ])
    return out

def span_features(text, spans):
    if not spans:
        return []
    def hit(p, x):
        return bool(re.search(p, x, re.I))
    def context(a, b):
        lo = max(text.rfind("\n", 0, a), text.rfind(".", 0, a)) + 1
        z = max(a, b - 1)
        ends = [q for q in (text.find("\n", z), text.find(".", z)) if q >= 0]
        hi = min(ends) + 1 if ends else len(text)
        return text[lo:hi]
    out = []
    for a, b in spans:
        a = max(0, min(len(text), a)); b = max(a, min(len(text), b))
        c = context(a, b)
        emp = hit(r"employee|internal .*staff|officer|director|personnel", c)
        ext = hit(r"consultant|agent|contractor|affiliate|representative|third part", c)
        copy = hit(r"cop(?:y|ies|ied)|reproduc|photograph", c)
        solicit = hit(r"solicit|employ|hire|contact for employment|engage .*employee", c)
        proxy = hit(r"prox(?:y|ies)|vote|voting|consent", c)
        out.append([
            emp,
            ext,
            hit(r"counsel|attorney|accountant|professional adviser|financial advisor|banker|legal counsel", c),
            hit(r"need to know|require access|strictly need|directly concerned|involved in|reasonably require", c),
            hit(r"agree .*bound|confidentiality agreement|secrecy agreement|terms no less|keep .*confidence|duty of confidence|informed .*confidential", c),
            hit(r"may disclose|permitted to disclose|except .*employees|except .*representatives|disclos(?:e|ure) .* to", c) and (emp or ext),
            copy and hit(r"except .*necessary|copies required|strictly necessary|prior written (?:consent|approval)|written permission|for .*purpose", c),
            copy and hit(r"shall not|not (?:copy|reproduce|photograph)|without prior written|agrees not", c),
            copy and hit(r"return|destroy|no copies .*retained", c),
            solicit and emp and not proxy,
            hit(r"solicitation", c) and proxy,
            solicit and hit(r"general advertisement|general solicitation|not specifically target|recruitment agency|initiates? discussions|responds? to .*advertisement|ceased to be employed", c)
        ])
    return out
